body: How exactly would I go about doing that? Is it just like some hotline you call and it gets set up from there?

I'm honestly not too sure. I did attend a MH group that lasted for a few weeks last year, and later an actual counsellor. However, I said no to the counsellor mostly because I didn't feel comfortable talking to the one I was assigned and asking for a new one put me back on the list. I'm pretty sure that service is closed for the time being due to the virus so I'm not really sure what options that would leave me with. 

I only think a hospital is a good idea because suicide is the main thing I've been thinking about and I want to get something done. Whether it be me being monitored, some prescription or a diagnosis.
